## Our Pledge

rainbowR is committed to providing a welcoming, inclusive, and harassment-free experience for everyone. We welcome people of all backgrounds and identities.

## Expected Behaviour

Participants are expected to be respectful, considerate, and collaborative. Help create a space where people can participate fully, learn, and make connections.

## Unacceptable Behaviour

Harassment, discrimination, intimidation, or other conduct that could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting is not acceptable. This includes behaviour directed at people because of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, race, ethnicity, religion, age, or other protected characteristics.

## Enforcement Responsibilities

The Code of Conduct team is responsible for clarifying and enforcing these standards and for taking appropriate, fair action in response to behaviour that is inappropriate, threatening, offensive, or harmful.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies throughout conference spaces and to people representing the conference in public spaces.

## Reporting

The event-specific reporting contact and any independent escalation route must be added here before registration opens. Until then, refer to the [rainbowR Code of Conduct](https://rainbowr.org/code-of-conduct).

## Timeline, process, and appeal

Document the process for reviewing reports, communicating outcomes, and appealing decisions here before the event.

## Enforcement Guidelines

Add the event’s enforcement guidelines here. The prior conference page used a graduated approach covering correction, warning, temporary ban, and permanent ban.

## Attribution

The conference Code of Conduct should acknowledge the sources or community standards it is adapted from.
